beats.narration_slice: People would weigh half as much on Earth.
beats.visual: A clay Earth park scene showing two identical people on a balance platform, one normal-weight reference silhouette and one lightly compressed scale effect with a clear upward lift feeling, surrounded by familiar trees and ground.
beats.purpose: show that people would experience half their current weight on Earth
beats.visual_fingerprint: two clay human figures on a rounded outdoor weighing platform, eye-level wide shot, grassy Earth park setting, one figure visibly lifted by reduced weight
beats.continuity: first body image establishes the altered-gravity Earth setting

beats.narration_slice: They could jump higher and lift heavy objects more easily.
beats.visual: A clay person making a high jump beside a large stone block being lifted with ease, with soft motion arcs suggested through bent poses and floating dust.
beats.purpose: show increased jumping ability and easier lifting under lower gravity
beats.visual_fingerprint: single clay person soaring above a village path while raising a heavy stone block, low-angle action composition with open sky background
beats.continuity: same altered-gravity world, moving from body weight to movement effects

beats.narration_slice: A person could carry a large box with less effort.
beats.visual: A clay person calmly carrying an oversized cardboard box across a warehouse floor, showing relaxed posture despite the box size.
beats.purpose: show reduced effort when carrying heavy objects
beats.visual_fingerprint: oversized clay box carried by a small relaxed figure, medium side view, indoor storage space with stacked objects
beats.continuity: moves from jumping and lifting to everyday tasks

beats.narration_slice: Bridges and buildings would face different forces.
beats.visual: A clay city scene with a bridge and tall buildings showing altered support loads through thicker beams, curved supports, and people observing from below.
beats.purpose: show that structures experience changed forces in lower gravity
beats.visual_fingerprint: wide clay city canyon with bridge crossing between buildings, elevated camera angle, structural elements emphasized through exposed supports
beats.continuity: expands from personal effects to large-scale systems

beats.narration_slice: Some structures might need new designs.
beats.visual: A clay architect workspace with a model bridge being reshaped with stronger-looking curved supports and new forms.
beats.purpose: show possible redesigns for structures in a different gravity environment
beats.visual_fingerprint: close clay tabletop view of hands modifying a miniature bridge model, workshop setting with tools and sculpted pieces
beats.continuity: same engineering theme, shifts from existing structures to adaptation

beats.narration_slice: Cars and machines would move differently.
beats.visual: Clay vehicles traveling on a road with a truck and construction machine showing altered suspension and motion, surrounded by a soft dusty landscape.
beats.purpose: show how vehicles and machines could behave differently with lower weight
beats.visual_fingerprint: three clay machines on a curved road, rear three-quarter camera angle, outdoor industrial zone with altered vehicle movement
beats.continuity: continues from structural changes to mechanical systems

beats.narration_slice: Astronauts already experience very low gravity in space.
beats.visual: A clay astronaut floating inside a spacecraft cabin with soft Earth visible through a window, showing the familiar low-gravity experience.
beats.purpose: connect low gravity on Earth to an experience astronauts already have
beats.visual_fingerprint: floating clay astronaut inside rounded spacecraft interior, close vertical composition with Earth in background window
beats.continuity: moves from machines on Earth to a real low-gravity environment

beats.narration_slice: A half-gravity Earth could look familiar but act differently.
beats.visual: A clay landscape that resembles a normal Earth park while people, trees, and vehicles show subtle unusual movement from lower gravity.
beats.purpose: show that the planet could appear familiar while behaving differently
beats.visual_fingerprint: full clay park panorama with ordinary scenery, floating leaves, higher jumps and altered vehicle motion, centered wide composition
beats.continuity: returns from space to a changed Earth overview

beats.narration_slice: Many systems would need to adjust to lower weight.
beats.visual: A clay montage-like city block scene showing transportation, buildings, and daily activity adapting with redesigned supports and machinery.
beats.purpose: show broad adjustments needed across human systems
beats.visual_fingerprint: vertical clay city block composition with roads, buildings, and machines arranged in layers showing adaptation across society
beats.continuity: widens the previous Earth view into a systems-level conclusion

beats.narration_slice: Lighter does not mean the same.
beats.visual: A clay Earth scene split by composition rather than borders, with familiar landscapes on one side and subtly changed movement and structures on the other.
beats.purpose: summarize that reduced weight changes behavior without making Earth identical
beats.visual_fingerprint: final clay planetary landscape with familiar terrain, altered motion cues, and redesigned structures, cinematic vertical wide shot
beats.continuity: final reflection image gathering the topic changes into one world view
